title: Caution Ahead: Numerical Reasoning and Look-ahead Bias in AI Models

scopes.description: Complete author-documented Python pipeline launched by main.py: Compustat annual/quarterly preparation, generated financial statements, numerical-reasoning analysis, lab-free cutoff-model analysis, commercial LLM analysis and GBDT analysis. Numerical task values are drawn from processed Compustat firm-year rows; GBDT features and rolling models are generated by supplied code. Full-pipeline closure remains incomplete because raw Compustat, construction maps, prompt data and exact author-trained local checkpoints require verification, and commercial/numerical service-output caches or live-model routes are unresolved.

requirements.description: Raw Compustat annual fundamentals used to build the 1968–2021 USD domestic industrial sample. The code queries COMP.FUNDA or reads compustat/comp_funda_20241105.parquet; required fixed fields are gvkey, cik, conm, datadate, datafmt, consol, popsrc, indfmt, curcd, fyr, fyear, ls, prcc_f, csho, revt, lse, ch, ivst and ni, plus fields named by the balance-sheet/income-statement construction files and their balancing formulas. The processed annual file joins next-fiscal-year earnings (ni_p1); this is source input, not a generated file requirement.

issues.description: The work-item dependency parser registered zero edges, but manual source tracing shows two external raw Compustat products, two unproduced statement-construction maps, a year-specific prompt map, and author-trained Pythia cutoff checkpoints. Generated annual/report-date parquets and baseline statement JSON files have supplied producers. The local COMP.FUNDQ file is now verified readable with the eight requested source columns and supports same-product staging; filter-specific population, nonmissing RDQ and matched-key coverage, and the required history remain unverified. Annual Compustat field compatibility still depends on missing mapping/projection provenance; external-root contents and some model/API branches also remain unresolved.

The balance-sheet and income-statement construction CSVs are read as mandatory inputs and determine raw field names and balancing formulas. No producer or complete field/formula specification is present in the supplied programs; the missing mappings prevent closing the raw Compustat field and generated-statement compatibility trace.

Commercial predictions require year-specific system prompts from a compressed JSON mapping, but the code does not produce the mapping and the package inventory does not include it. Prompt text and coverage across used years need author confirmation.

Lab-free inference only loads cutoff-specific local final directories; supplied programs neither train nor download them. The exact 1999–2023 cutoff model weights, tokenizers, configs and training revisions are not supplied or verified.

Commercial and numerical stages depend on externally generated LLM outputs. In the default configuration live requests are disabled and the minimum cache hit rate is 1.0; response and extraction caches can therefore serve as an author-prepared output bypass, but the package inventory contains no cache databases and the external data root and README checksum-manifest contents were not inspected. The commercial code pins gpt-4-0125-preview and gpt-3.5-turbo-0125, which the provider reports shut down on March 26 and October 23, 2026; its gpt-4o snapshots and the numerical stage's gpt-4o snapshots are deprecated with a January 14, 2027 shutdown date. Parser aliases gpt-4o and gpt-4o-mini are also present. Exact cache coverage, cache provenance, user API access and any author-approved migration remain unknown; do not substitute models or treat caches as raw source data.
